name: SN-22
summary: SN-22, also known as 3-(1-methyl-4-piperidinyl)indole, is a serotonin receptor modulator of the piperidinylindole group related to the psychedelic drug dimethyltryptamine (DMT). Though it is not technically a tryptamine itself, SN-22 can be regarded as a constrained analogue of DMT.
